subject: Zoology
exam_context: NEET UG 2026 - Zoology half of the Biology section, conventionally 45 scored questions / 180 marks (Biology overall: 90 scored questions / 360 marks, split evenly between Botany and Zoology by most coaching trackers)
data_provenance: Estimated from PYQ-trend analysis and chapter-wise-weightage trackers aggregated across 2025 and 2026 NEET sessions (including the 21 June 2026 Re-NEET UG), not official NTA data; last grounded Sep 2026. NTA does not publish a separate Botany/Zoology split, so figures here reflect the conventional coaching-tracker split and multi-session averages, not a guarantee of any single paper's composition.

Z01.notes: Repeatedly flagged as the single highest- or second-highest-weightage Biology chapter; phylum-feature and classification-exception questions dominate.

Z02.notes: Cockroach anatomy and tissue-type identification questions recur.

Z03.notes: Mechanism-of-breathing and gas-transport questions recur; grouped with Human Physiology as a high-yield bloc.

Z04.notes: Cardiac-cycle and blood-composition questions are a recurring high-yield archetype.

Z07.notes: Nerve-impulse and brain-structure questions are a consistently recurring archetype.

Z08.notes: Endocrine-gland/hormone-function matching questions recur; a reliable easy-marks chapter.

Z09.notes: Mendelian-cross and pedigree-analysis numericals/logic questions are a consistently top-tier archetype; genetic-disorder identification recurs.

Z10.notes: Direct NCERT-fact recall on evidences and mechanisms of evolution; a reliable easy-marks chapter.

Z11.notes: Gametogenesis and menstrual-cycle questions recur; consistently a high-weightage chapter.

Z12.notes: Direct NCERT-fact recall on contraception/ART methods; a reliable easy-marks chapter.

Z13.notes: Pathogen-disease matching and immunity-type questions are a consistently recurring, generally easy-to-medium archetype.

broad_category_weightage_pct.note: Coarser cross-check figures, approximate % share of the 45-question scored Zoology half, synthesised from multiple 2025-2026 PYQ trend sources. Rounds do not sum exactly to 100%.

marking_scheme.source_note: Confirmed via multiple Sep 2026 sources reporting on the 2026 and Re-NEET UG 2026 (21 June 2026) sessions.
marking_scheme.section_a_share: Biology Section A has 70 single-correct MCQs, all compulsory (conventionally ~35 Zoology-origin); +4 correct, -1 incorrect, 0 unattempted.
marking_scheme.section_b_share: Biology Section B has 30 single-correct MCQs, attempt any 20, best 20 scored (conventionally ~15 Zoology-origin); +4 correct, -1 incorrect, 0 unattempted.
